2a = \frac{137}{49} - 97 = \frac{137-4753}{49} = -\frac{4616}{49}.

The even-indexed terms form an arithmetic sequence:
\[
a_2+a_4+\cdots+a_{98}
\]
with 49 terms, first term \(a_2=a+1\), common difference \(2\). Its sum is
\[
\frac{49}{2}\left(2(a+1)+48\cdot 2\right)
= \frac{49}{2}(2a+98).
\]
Since \(2a=-\frac{4616}{49}\),
\[
2a+98 = -\frac{4616}{49}+98 = \frac{186}{49}.
\]
Thus the sum is
\[
\frac{49}{2}\cdot \frac{186}{49}=\frac{186}{2}=93.
\]

\boxed{93}
